question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.

Brazen
solution:
The correct answer is: **Timid**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Brazen"** means bold and without shame; it can also refer to something done in an open and shocking way without concern for the reaction. (धृष्ट, बेहया)

 
 
• **Example:** He made a brazen attempt to cheat during the exam, disregarding the consequences.
 
 
 
• **"Timid"** refers to someone who is shy, lacking confidence, or easily frightened. It is the opposite of "Brazen," which implies boldness. (डरपोक, संकोची)
 
 
• **Example:** The timid child hid behind her mother when strangers approached.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the antonym of **"Brazen"** is **"Timid"**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Timid**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Anxious** (चिंतित): Feeling worried or uneasy about something uncertain.

 
 
• **Example:** She felt anxious about her upcoming job interview.
 
 
 
• **Concerned** (चिंतित): Showing worry or interest in something.
 
 
• **Example:** He was deeply concerned about the environmental impact of the construction project.
 
 
 
• **Distinct** (स्पष्ट): Clearly different or easily distinguishable.
 
 
• **Example:** The two paintings have distinct styles that set them apart.
